method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); four regulative rules (the plaintiff's notices to the registrar, cl 16(6), 23(5), 34(2); the further information before mediation, cl 26(8); a defendant's medical examination notice and examination, cl 29(1), (2); payment under an accepted offer with withdrawal under LEST, cl 88(6), 93(1)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; business days and the 25 December - 9 January period counted in ddtr-dates.l4 with built-in date functions; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the claimant: the plaintiff who is or was suffering from the asbestos-related condition, or a person claiming through them (including a Compensation to Relatives Act 1897 claim), and after the plaintiff's death the authorised representative; in Part 5 the plaintiff includes a cross-claimant
